_doc: Manually curated recipes for classic metrics that detect can't recover empirically. These get folded into aws_mapping.with_recipes.json by `cct merge-recipes` AFTER the auto-detected recipes (so manual entries win on conflict).

compositeFormulas.explanation: Classic Dynatrace computed this as the percentage of provisioned read capacity actually consumed. No single CloudWatch metric is equivalent — the percentage is rebuilt from two raw CW metrics.
compositeFormulas.verificationNotes: 2026-05-06: empirical test on table cwd-sitrep-table-dev showed formula doesn't fit. classic values (54-307) don't reconcile with (consumed_sum/3600)/provisioned*100 (which gives 50-80). Ratio is variable 1-4x. Classic likely has additional factors (sampling differences, custom burst calculation, or different denominator). DO NOT TRUST until classic source code or DAC team confirms exact formula.
